meta.title: The Clouds Part
meta.description: The mists melt away and the radiant sun ascends.

units.rawText: Is Hellflame Slash your new move? Looks pretty cool... Hmm... not as cool as mine, though.
units.displayText: Is Hellflame Slash your new move? Looks pretty cool... Hmm... not as cool as mine, though.

spans.text: Is Hellflame Slash your new move? Looks pretty cool... Hmm... not as cool as mine, though.

units.rawText: Big talk from someone who got smacked down.
units.displayText: Big talk from someone who got smacked down.

spans.text: Big talk from someone who got smacked down.

units.rawText: Hey, my foot slipped, I totally wasn't dodging it just now. Like c'mon, I've been asleep for a long time without fighting, cut me some slack, will you?
units.displayText: Hey, my foot slipped, I totally wasn't dodging it just now. Like c'mon, I've been asleep for a long time without fighting, cut me some slack, will you?

units.rawText: Speaking of which, you should be more concerned about yourself. You're going to leak out all your operands if you don't patch that hole in your chest.
units.displayText: Speaking of which, you should be more concerned about yourself. You're going to leak out all your operands if you don't patch that hole in your chest.

spans.text: Speaking of which, you should be more concerned about yourself. You're going to leak out all your operands if you don't patch that hole in your chest.

units.rawText: Who knows, maybe you'll end up so weak that I can take you out with a single flick to the forehead.
units.displayText: Who knows, maybe you'll end up so weak that I can take you out with a single flick to the forehead.

spans.text: Who knows, maybe you'll end up so weak that I can take you out with a single flick to the forehead.

units.rawText: Oh, you're one to talk. Cough, you're practically transparent at this point... So stop looking down on others.

spans.text: Oh, you're one to talk. Cough, you're practically transparent at this point... So stop looking down on others.

units.rawText: If it wasn't for the Halo, a tiny scratch like this wouldn't even faze me... (pants)

units.rawText: Damn, that Entropized body of yours is really something. I'd still win, though.
units.displayText: Damn, that Entropized body of yours is really something. I'd still win, though.

spans.text: Damn, that Entropized body of yours is really something. I'd still win, though.

units.rawText: Quit dreaming, dork.
units.displayText: Quit dreaming, dork.

spans.text: Quit dreaming, dork.

units.displayText: Sol tightens her grip on her sword, and then she suddenly bursts into laughter.

spans.text: Sol tightens her grip on her sword, and then she suddenly bursts into laughter.

units.rawText: Hahahahaha...
units.displayText: Hahahahaha...

spans.text: Hahahahaha...

units.rawText: Right, so, jokes aside... I have like one more attack left in me.
units.displayText: Right, so, jokes aside... I have like one more attack left in me.

spans.text: Right, so, jokes aside... I have like one more attack left in me.

units.rawText: Entropic Sol glances at her and reluctantly replies.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol glances at her and reluctantly replies.

spans.text: Entropic Sol glances at her and reluctantly replies.

units.rawText: Same here.
units.displayText: Same here.

spans.text: Same here.

units.rawText: Then let's settle things with one last blow.
units.displayText: Then let's settle things with one last blow.

spans.text: Then let's settle things with one last blow.

units.rawText: The pair exchange glances, then quickly open up the distance between them.
units.displayText: The pair exchange glances, then quickly open up the distance between them.

spans.text: The pair exchange glances, then quickly open up the distance between them.

units.rawText: Then, with unspoken synchronicity, they pivot, leap from where they're standing, and draw their blades.
units.displayText: Then, with unspoken synchronicity, they pivot, leap from where they're standing, and draw their blades.

units.displayText: Hellflame Slash—

units.displayText: The two blades collide in mid-air.

units.rawText: Hrk!
units.displayText: Hrk!

units.rawText: Operands take concrete form as flames, which rage into each other. On the sidelines, Persicaria protects the human in her arms and the young Entropic behind her, sheltering them from the wave of heat that's washing over them.
units.displayText: Operands take concrete form as flames, which rage into each other. On the sidelines, Persicaria protects the human in her arms and the young Entropic behind her, sheltering them from the wave of heat that's washing over them.

units.displayText: As the blaze dies down, so does the storm of raging operands.

spans.text: As the blaze dies down, so does the storm of raging operands.

units.rawText: The battling pair are standing still and watching each other. The keenness is gone from their gazes, replaced by stubbornness and fatigue.
units.displayText: The battling pair are standing still and watching each other. The keenness is gone from their gazes, replaced by stubbornness and fatigue.

units.displayText: The sound of a weapon falling to the ground breaks the tense standoff.

spans.text: The sound of a weapon falling to the ground breaks the tense standoff.

units.displayText: The girl in black wobbles, and then she slowly collapses.

spans.text: The girl in black wobbles, and then she slowly collapses.

units.rawText: Thump—
units.displayText: Thump—

spans.text: Thump—

units.rawText: ...I've lost.
units.displayText: ...I've lost.

spans.text: ...I've lost.

units.rawText: Haha, if you'd held out just a bit longer, I would have been the one who went down.
units.displayText: Haha, if you'd held out just a bit longer, I would have been the one who went down.

spans.text: Haha, if you'd held out just a bit longer, I would have been the one who went down.

units.rawText: As Sol said, she is in a very tenuous state. She was barely managing to sustain her physical body with a limited supply of operands, and the massive expenditure in the battle just now has rendered her body translucent. Even so, she uses her sword as a crutch and limps over to Entropic Sol.

units.rawText: You're really strong... Thank you for letting me enjoy that fight.
units.displayText: You're really strong... Thank you for letting me enjoy that fight.

spans.text: You're really strong... Thank you for letting me enjoy that fight.

units.rawText: Same here. I haven't had this much fun in a while.
units.displayText: Same here. I haven't had this much fun in a while.

spans.text: Same here. I haven't had this much fun in a while.

units.rawText: Well, to the victor go the spoils. I'll give you your core back...
units.displayText: Well, to the victor go the spoils. I'll give you your core back...

spans.text: Well, to the victor go the spoils. I'll give you your core back...

units.rawText: Entropic Sol's hand trembles as she touches her core, but then a pair of hands grabs them and stops her.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol's hand trembles as she touches her core, but then a pair of hands grabs them and stops her.

spans.text: Entropic Sol's hand trembles as she touches her core, but then a pair of hands grabs them and stops her.

units.rawText: Who says I want your core?
units.displayText: Who says I want your core?

spans.text: Who says I want your core?

units.rawText: Rather, I should be giving you back the stake from your chest.
units.displayText: Rather, I should be giving you back the stake from your chest.

units.rawText: <size=40>Sol!</size>
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Persicaria grabs Sol's arm. The look in her eyes says she doesn't get it at all.
units.displayText: Persicaria grabs Sol's arm. The look in her eyes says she doesn't get it at all.

spans.text: Persicaria grabs Sol's arm. The look in her eyes says she doesn't get it at all.

units.rawText: Are you saying that you can still survive without her core?
units.displayText: Are you saying that you can still survive without her core?

spans.text: Are you saying that you can still survive without her core?

units.rawText: Well, I, er... I don't know, actually.
units.displayText: Well, I, er... I don't know, actually.

spans.text: Well, I, er... I don't know, actually.

units.rawText: The truth is, I don't even know how I ended up here in this state.
units.displayText: The truth is, I don't even know how I ended up here in this state.

spans.text: The truth is, I don't even know how I ended up here in this state.

units.rawText: What on earth is going on? All I remember is that when the bottle broke...
units.displayText: What on earth is going on? All I remember is that when the bottle broke...

spans.text: What on earth is going on? All I remember is that when the bottle broke...

units.rawText: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.
units.displayText: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.

spans.text: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.

units.rawText: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it and shining with a blinding light.
units.displayText: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it and shining with a blinding light.

spans.text: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it and shining with a blinding light.

units.rawText: Ah! I remember now. In the past, I thought that it would be a pain to manually infuse operands into the bottle containing that leaf, so I left a neural fragment in the bottle.
units.displayText: Ah! I remember now. In the past, I thought that it would be a pain to manually infuse operands into the bottle containing that leaf, so I left a neural fragment in the bottle.

spans.text: Ah! I remember now. In the past, I thought that it would be a pain to manually infuse operands into the bottle containing that leaf, so I left a neural fragment in the bottle.

units.rawText: That way, the leaf would be nourished by the fragment as long as I was still alive. However, I didn't think about what would happen after I died. It should have withered away immediately once the fragment's operands were used up...
units.displayText: That way, the leaf would be nourished by the fragment as long as I was still alive. However, I didn't think about what would happen after I died. It should have withered away immediately once the fragment's operands were used up...

spans.text: That way, the leaf would be nourished by the fragment as long as I was still alive. However, I didn't think about what would happen after I died. It should have withered away immediately once the fragment's operands were used up...

units.rawText: In which world does someone put a piece of their neural cloud into a plant they're caring for? You mega dork!
units.displayText: In which world does someone put a piece of their neural cloud into a plant they're caring for? You mega dork!

spans.text: In which world does someone put a piece of their neural cloud into a plant they're caring for? You mega dork!

units.rawText: Still, thanks to you being a dork, and me constantly infusing the bottle with operands, the fragment managed to survive... Could we call this good luck...
units.displayText: Still, thanks to you being a dork, and me constantly infusing the bottle with operands, the fragment managed to survive... Could we call this good luck...

spans.text: Still, thanks to you being a dork, and me constantly infusing the bottle with operands, the fragment managed to survive... Could we call this good luck...

units.rawText: Hehe, it's definitely not just because of luck! It's all because I've been studying up!
units.displayText: Hehe, it's definitely not just because of luck! It's all because I've been studying up!

spans.text: Hehe, it's definitely not just because of luck! It's all because I've been studying up!

units.rawText: Still, I do seem to recall you regularly pouring operands into the bottle, as well as all the stuff you were muttering to it.
units.displayText: Still, I do seem to recall you regularly pouring operands into the bottle, as well as all the stuff you were muttering to it.

spans.text: Still, I do seem to recall you regularly pouring operands into the bottle, as well as all the stuff you were muttering to it.

units.rawText: Stuff like how a ton of new Dolls came to the Oasis while I was gone, that there was a woman among them called Sangoma who kept pestering the Professor and how she had the most enormous pair of brea—
units.displayText: Stuff like how a ton of new Dolls came to the Oasis while I was gone, that there was a woman among them called Sangoma who kept pestering the Professor and how she had the most enormous pair of brea—

units.rawText: <size=40>That's enough, Sol!</size>
units.displayText: That's enough, Sol!

spans.text: That's enough, Sol!

units.rawText: Persicaria's face turns red.
units.displayText: Persicaria's face turns red.

spans.text: Persicaria's face turns red.

units.rawText: (Clears throat) Uh... So what else do you remember?
units.displayText: (Clears throat) Uh... So what else do you remember?

spans.text: (Clears throat) Uh... So what else do you remember?

units.rawText: Hm, apart from your voice, I also heard the other "Sol's" voice.
units.displayText: Hm, apart from your voice, I also heard the other "Sol's" voice.

spans.text: Hm, apart from your voice, I also heard the other "Sol's" voice.

units.rawText: Sol looks toward the girl in black.
units.displayText: Sol looks toward the girl in black.

spans.text: Sol looks toward the girl in black.

units.rawText: You were talking to yourself and going "Shut up!" and "Don't consume me!" and whatnot...
units.displayText: You were talking to yourself and going "Shut up!" and "Don't consume me!" and whatnot...

spans.text: You were talking to yourself and going "Shut up!" and "Don't consume me!" and whatnot...

units.rawText: Th-That's all in the past!
units.displayText: Th-That's all in the past!

spans.text: Th-That's all in the past!

units.rawText: So you're saying... there was a resonance with the neural fragment in the bottle because her body contained a core that was originally yours?
units.displayText: So you're saying... there was a resonance with the neural fragment in the bottle because her body contained a core that was originally yours?

spans.text: So you're saying... there was a resonance with the neural fragment in the bottle because her body contained a core that was originally yours?

units.rawText: The stake and its chains contained your neural cloud data, and when it made contact with the neural fragment in the bottle, it somehow managed to piece together a largely intact neural cloud.
units.displayText: The stake and its chains contained your neural cloud data, and when it made contact with the neural fragment in the bottle, it somehow managed to piece together a largely intact neural cloud.

spans.text: The stake and its chains contained your neural cloud data, and when it made contact with the neural fragment in the bottle, it somehow managed to piece together a largely intact neural cloud.

units.rawText: And then the steady stream of operands leaking from the avulsed core fragment constituted a power supply for the composite cloud, which led you to manifest in this form.
units.displayText: And then the steady stream of operands leaking from the avulsed core fragment constituted a power supply for the composite cloud, which led you to manifest in this form.

spans.text: And then the steady stream of operands leaking from the avulsed core fragment constituted a power supply for the composite cloud, which led you to manifest in this form.

units.rawText: Er, I don't get the whole neural cloud data and power supply thing... But the important thing is I'm here! Don't worry about the reason for it!
units.displayText: Er, I don't get the whole neural cloud data and power supply thing... But the important thing is I'm here! Don't worry about the reason for it!

spans.text: Er, I don't get the whole neural cloud data and power supply thing... But the important thing is I'm here! Don't worry about the reason for it!

units.rawText: However, this composite neural cloud can't process operands on its own. You're only here because your operand supply hasn't been depleted yet.
units.displayText: However, this composite neural cloud can't process operands on its own. You're only here because your operand supply hasn't been depleted yet.

spans.text: However, this composite neural cloud can't process operands on its own. You're only here because your operand supply hasn't been depleted yet.

units.rawText: At this rate, you're going to disappear...
units.displayText: At this rate, you're going to disappear...

spans.text: At this rate, you're going to disappear...

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the black-clad girl who's fallen to the ground and she suddenly realizes that there's a way to keep her friend from disappearing. She takes Sol by the shoulders and describes her suggestion in a serious tone of voice.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the black-clad girl who's fallen to the ground and she suddenly realizes that there's a way to keep her friend from disappearing. She takes Sol by the shoulders and describes her suggestion in a serious tone of voice.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the black-clad girl who's fallen to the ground and she suddenly realizes that there's a way to keep her friend from disappearing. She takes Sol by the shoulders and describes her suggestion in a serious tone of voice.

units.rawText: Sol, if we take your core back, your neural cloud will be restored to its complete state and you won't run the risk of running dry on operands.
units.displayText: Sol, if we take your core back, your neural cloud will be restored to its complete state and you won't run the risk of running dry on operands.

spans.text: Sol, if we take your core back, your neural cloud will be restored to its complete state and you won't run the risk of running dry on operands.

units.rawText: So...
units.displayText: So...

spans.text: So...

units.rawText: Persicaria, I can't do that.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I can't do that.

spans.text: Persicaria, I can't do that.

units.rawText: Sol's words extinguish the hope that had only just started blooming in Persicaria's heart.
units.displayText: Sol's words extinguish the hope that had only just started blooming in Persicaria's heart.

spans.text: Sol's words extinguish the hope that had only just started blooming in Persicaria's heart.

units.rawText: Why? No matter how great Antonina is, she can't make a frame without a body work...
units.displayText: Why? No matter how great Antonina is, she can't make a frame without a body work...

spans.text: Why? No matter how great Antonina is, she can't make a frame without a body work...

units.rawText: Don't you want to go back? You said something about how we could do stuff in the future...
units.displayText: Don't you want to go back? You said something about how we could do stuff in the future...

spans.text: Don't you want to go back? You said something about how we could do stuff in the future...

units.rawText: Of course I want to go back.
units.displayText: Of course I want to go back.

spans.text: Of course I want to go back.

units.rawText: But Persicaria, that core isn't mine anymore.
units.displayText: But Persicaria, that core isn't mine anymore.

spans.text: But Persicaria, that core isn't mine anymore.

units.rawText: Those words stun Persicaria and the hands she has placed on Sol's shoulders go stiff.
units.displayText: Those words stun Persicaria and the hands she has placed on Sol's shoulders go stiff.

spans.text: Those words stun Persicaria and the hands she has placed on Sol's shoulders go stiff.

units.rawText: I died, you know. The fact that I'm here at all is a miracle. There shouldn't be anything on the cloud that belongs to me.
units.displayText: I died, you know. The fact that I'm here at all is a miracle. There shouldn't be anything on the cloud that belongs to me.

died
, you know. The fact that I'm here at all is a miracle. There shouldn't be anything on the cloud that belongs to me.

units.rawText: Right now, this is her core. She is herself and not a substitute for me, or anyone, for that matter.
units.displayText: Right now, this is her core. She is herself and not a substitute for me, or anyone, for that matter.

spans.text: Right now, this is
her
core. She is herself and not a substitute for me, or anyone, for that matter.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: During her previous fight with Persicaria, the girl in black struggled and yelled with all her might.
units.displayText: During her previous fight with Persicaria, the girl in black struggled and yelled with all her might.

spans.text: During her previous fight with Persicaria, the girl in black struggled and yelled with all her might.

units.rawText: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!
units.displayText: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!

spans.text: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!

units.rawText: <size=40>And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!</size>
units.displayText: And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!

spans.text: And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!

units.rawText: Persicaria, do you remember what I told you before?
units.displayText: Persicaria, do you remember what I told you before?

spans.text: Persicaria, do you remember what I told you before?

units.rawText: It was before Simo's first field expedition after being reset. You asked me what I would do if I were reset and couldn't remember you guys.
units.displayText: It was before Simo's first field expedition after being reset. You asked me what I would do if I were reset and couldn't remember you guys.

spans.text: It was before Simo's first field expedition after being reset. You asked me what I would do if I were reset and couldn't remember you guys.

units.rawText: Of course I do. How could I forget?
units.displayText: Of course I do. How could I forget?

spans.text: Of course I do. How could I forget?

units.rawText: You said that if you forgot everyone, I should yell your name, and you'd remember me upon seeing my face.
units.displayText: You said that if you forgot everyone, I should yell your name, and you'd remember me upon seeing my face.

spans.text: You said that if you forgot everyone, I should yell your name, and you'd remember me upon seeing my face.

units.rawText: No! That's not the point!
units.displayText: No! That's not the point!

spans.text: No! That's not the point!

units.rawText: Sol karate-chops Persicaria on the forehead.
units.displayText: Sol karate-chops Persicaria on the forehead.

spans.text: Sol karate-chops Persicaria on the forehead.

units.rawText: The important part is the conversation after that!
units.displayText: The important part is the conversation after that!

spans.text: The important part is the conversation
after
that!

units.rawText: But what if you've forgotten us for so long that you don't even remember my face?
units.displayText: But what if you've forgotten us for so long that you don't even remember my face?

spans.text: But what if you've forgotten us for so long that you don't even remember my face?

units.rawText: Damn, Persicaria, you really do like thinking about this stuff, don't you...
units.displayText: Damn, Persicaria, you really do like thinking about this stuff, don't you...

spans.text: Damn, Persicaria, you really do like thinking about this stuff, don't you...

units.rawText: Let me see... if that happens, then the post-reset me will have lots of new experiences and new memories.
units.displayText: Let me see... if that happens, then the post-reset me will have lots of new experiences and new memories.

spans.text: Let me see... if that happens, then the post-reset me will have lots of new experiences and new memories.

units.rawText: So wouldn't that make us completely different people!? Which means what happens in the future shouldn't be up to me to decide.
units.displayText: So wouldn't that make us completely different people!? Which means what happens in the future shouldn't be up to me to decide.

spans.text: So wouldn't that make us completely different people!? Which means what happens in the future shouldn't be up to me to decide.

units.rawText: Rather, "she" should make that decision.
units.displayText: Rather, "she" should make that decision.

spans.text: Rather, "she" should make that decision.

units.rawText: Persicaria, she deserves a life of her own.
units.displayText: Persicaria, she deserves a life of her own.

spans.text: Persicaria, she deserves a life of her own.

units.rawText: ...Sol is right. The girl in black before us is a brand new entity in her own right.
units.displayText: ...Sol is right. The girl in black before us is a brand new entity in her own right.

spans.text: ...Sol is right. The girl in black before us is a brand new entity in her own right.

units.rawText: I have no right to take her life in order to fulfill my selfish desire to chase someone who's already gone.
units.displayText: I have no right to take her life in order to fulfill my selfish desire to chase someone who's already gone.

spans.text: I have no right to take her life in order to fulfill my selfish desire to chase someone who's already gone.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: Now, she has no more reason to stop Sol. Persicaria lets go and lets her decide what to do next.
units.displayText: Now, she has no more reason to stop Sol. Persicaria lets go and lets her decide what to do next.

spans.text: Now, she has no more reason to stop Sol. Persicaria lets go and lets her decide what to do next.

units.rawText: Thank you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Thank you, Persicaria.

spans.text: Thank you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Sol looks back into the face that resembles hers. Though filled with doubt and confusion, it now appears so full of life.
units.displayText: Sol looks back into the face that resembles hers. Though filled with doubt and confusion, it now appears so full of life.

spans.text: Sol looks back into the face that resembles hers. Though filled with doubt and confusion, it now appears so full of life.

units.displayText: Sol closes her eyes and reaches into her translucent body, biting back her discomfort as she pulls out the burning stake within.

spans.text: Sol closes her eyes and reaches into her translucent body, biting back her discomfort as she pulls out the burning stake within.

units.rawText: Uuuurgh...
units.displayText: Uuuurgh...

spans.text: Uuuurgh...

units.rawText: Her body becomes more and more transparent the more she pulls the stake from it. By the time it's completely out of her, Sol is so fragile that she looks like she might disappear at any moment.
units.displayText: Her body becomes more and more transparent the more she pulls the stake from it. By the time it's completely out of her, Sol is so fragile that she looks like she might disappear at any moment.

spans.text: Her body becomes more and more transparent the more she pulls the stake from it. By the time it's completely out of her, Sol is so fragile that she looks like she might disappear at any moment.

units.rawText: (Wheezes) Good thing I don't feel pain...
units.displayText: (Wheezes) Good thing I don't feel pain...

spans.text: (Wheezes) Good thing I don't feel pain...

units.rawText: So yeah, this is yours. Take good care of it, okay?
units.displayText: So yeah, this is yours. Take good care of it, okay?

spans.text: So yeah, this is yours. Take good care of it, okay?

units.rawText: Why are you doing this...
units.displayText: Why are you doing this...

spans.text: Why are you doing this...

units.rawText: You want to know why? Maybe I was just influenced by your neural cloud. There's nobody who knows your confusion and pain better than I do...
units.displayText: You want to know why? Maybe I was just influenced by your neural cloud. There's nobody who knows your confusion and pain better than I do...

spans.text: You want to know why? Maybe I was just influenced by your neural cloud. There's nobody who knows your confusion and pain better than I do...

units.rawText: So at some point, I ended up treating you as a friend... Haha, even though you're an Entropic and all...
units.displayText: So at some point, I ended up treating you as a friend... Haha, even though you're an Entropic and all...

spans.text: So at some point, I ended up treating you as a friend... Haha, even though you're an Entropic and all...

units.rawText: We share some of the same data too, so when I look at you sometimes, it's like looking at myself...
units.displayText: We share some of the same data too, so when I look at you sometimes, it's like looking at myself...

spans.text: We share some of the same data too, so when I look at you sometimes, it's like looking at myself...

units.rawText: And I don't want to see you tying yourself up in knots over small things... And I don't want to see you confused and in pain either.
units.displayText: And I don't want to see you tying yourself up in knots over small things... And I don't want to see you confused and in pain either.

spans.text: And I don't want to see you tying yourself up in knots over small things... And I don't want to see you confused and in pain either.

units.rawText: The girl in black looks at the fire in Sol's hand, but she doesn't take it. She knows that if she cuts off her operand supply, she might never see the person before her again.
units.displayText: The girl in black looks at the fire in Sol's hand, but she doesn't take it. She knows that if she cuts off her operand supply, she might never see the person before her again.

spans.text: The girl in black looks at the fire in Sol's hand, but she doesn't take it. She knows that if she cuts off her operand supply, she might never see the person before her again.

units.rawText: Are you still scared?
units.displayText: Are you still scared?

spans.text: Are you still scared?

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Once you get this neural cloud back, or rather this partial neural cloud, will you still be scared and confused?
units.displayText: Once you get this neural cloud back, or rather this partial neural cloud, will you still be scared and confused?

spans.text: Once you get this neural cloud back, or rather this partial neural cloud, will you still be scared and confused?

units.rawText: The chains on the stake rattle. The girl in black looks at them; her prior disgust and rejection of them are long gone.
units.displayText: The chains on the stake rattle. The girl in black looks at them; her prior disgust and rejection of them are long gone.

spans.text: The chains on the stake rattle. The girl in black looks at them; her prior disgust and rejection of them are long gone.

units.rawText: Throwing the past away won't free you. It'll just make you more confused.
units.displayText: Throwing the past away won't free you. It'll just make you more confused.

spans.text: Throwing the past away won't free you. It'll just make you more confused.

units.rawText: If you can't see your past, you won't know who or where you are in the present. Naturally, you won't have a clue where you'll be going in the future too.
units.displayText: If you can't see your past, you won't know who or where you are in the present. Naturally, you won't have a clue where you'll be going in the future too.

spans.text: If you can't see your past, you won't know who or where you are in the present. Naturally, you won't have a clue where you'll be going in the future too.

units.rawText: If you're not sure how to proceed with things going forward, why don't you try accepting your past?
units.displayText: If you're not sure how to proceed with things going forward, why don't you try accepting your past?

spans.text: If you're not sure how to proceed with things going forward, why don't you try accepting your past?

units.rawText: ...I'm willing to try. But your neural cloud data's inside here. Are you sure you want to entrust it to me?
units.displayText: ...I'm willing to try. But your neural cloud data's inside here. Are you sure you want to entrust it to me?

spans.text: ...I'm willing to try. But your neural cloud data's inside here. Are you sure you want to entrust it to me?

units.rawText: You know, I remember all that stuff. Even without it, I'll still remember the days I spent with everyone in the Oasis.
units.displayText: You know, I remember all that stuff. Even without it, I'll still remember the days I spent with everyone in the Oasis.

spans.text: You know, I remember all that stuff. Even without it, I'll still remember the days I spent with everyone in the Oasis.

units.rawText: Unlike a certain dork.
units.displayText: Unlike a certain dork.

spans.text: Unlike a certain dork.

units.rawText: The girl in orange appears fragile, but she stands tall with her hands planted on her waist, like she's some great sage dispensing her wisdom. The Entropized girl looks at Sol and finally reaches a solution.
units.displayText: The girl in orange appears fragile, but she stands tall with her hands planted on her waist, like she's some great sage dispensing her wisdom. The Entropized girl looks at Sol and finally reaches a solution.

spans.text: The girl in orange appears fragile, but she stands tall with her hands planted on her waist, like she's some great sage dispensing her wisdom. The Entropized girl looks at Sol and finally reaches a solution.

units.rawText: She slowly reaches out and touches the fire burning in Sol's hand.
units.displayText: She slowly reaches out and touches the fire burning in Sol's hand.

spans.text: She slowly reaches out and touches the fire burning in Sol's hand.

units.rawText: It is warm and bright. The stake and chain return to where they ought to be and fill the hole in her chest. Yet, Sol's body seems ever more transparent in the firelight.
units.displayText: It is warm and bright. The stake and chain return to where they ought to be and fill the hole in her chest. Yet, Sol's body seems ever more transparent in the firelight.

spans.text: It is warm and bright. The stake and chain return to where they ought to be and fill the hole in her chest. Yet, Sol's body seems ever more transparent in the firelight.

units.rawText: Just as Sol is about to collapse, the Entropized girl reaches out to help her keep standing, and then she lightly places her hand on Sol's chest.
units.displayText: Just as Sol is about to collapse, the Entropized girl reaches out to help her keep standing, and then she lightly places her hand on Sol's chest.

spans.text: Just as Sol is about to collapse, the Entropized girl reaches out to help her keep standing, and then she lightly places her hand on Sol's chest.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: It's kind of unfair to hog all the cool moments for yourself, you know.
units.displayText: It's kind of unfair to hog all the cool moments for yourself, you know.

spans.text: It's kind of unfair to hog all the cool moments for yourself, you know.

units.rawText: I'll give you some of my operands. That ought to help you recover quickly.
units.displayText: I'll give you some of my operands. That ought to help you recover quickly.

spans.text: I'll give you some of my operands. That ought to help you recover quickly.

units.rawText: The black-clad girl watches as Sol's face regains its color and smiles.
units.displayText: The black-clad girl watches as Sol's face regains its color and smiles.

spans.text: The black-clad girl watches as Sol's face regains its color and smiles.

units.rawText: <size=40>I've accepted you as a worthy opponent! We'll fight again once you get back to 100% strength!</size>
units.displayText: I've accepted you as a worthy opponent! We'll fight again once you get back to 100% strength!

spans.text: I've accepted you as a worthy opponent! We'll fight again once you get back to 100% strength!

units.rawText: ...Sure thing! It's a deal!
units.displayText: ...Sure thing! It's a deal!

spans.text: ...Sure thing! It's a deal!

units.rawText: Sol can feel the operands flowing into her. They mix with the other data in her body, permeating it, fusing with it until they reach a subtle, harmonious balance.
units.displayText: Sol can feel the operands flowing into her. They mix with the other data in her body, permeating it, fusing with it until they reach a subtle, harmonious balance.

spans.text: Sol can feel the operands flowing into her. They mix with the other data in her body, permeating it, fusing with it until they reach a subtle, harmonious balance.

units.rawText: So, how do you feel?
units.displayText: So, how do you feel?

spans.text: So, how do you feel?

units.rawText: <size=40>Way better!</size>
units.displayText: Way better!

spans.text: Way better!

units.rawText: Sol stretches and mimes a punch or two.
units.displayText: Sol stretches and mimes a punch or two.

spans.text: Sol stretches and mimes a punch or two.

units.rawText: I feel like I could go another 300 rounds with you!
units.displayText: I feel like I could go another 300 rounds with you!

spans.text: I feel like I could go another 300 rounds with you!

units.rawText: Pffft... Maybe you shouldn't waste your operands on that.
units.displayText: Pffft... Maybe you shouldn't waste your operands on that.

spans.text: Pffft... Maybe you shouldn't waste your operands on that.

units.rawText: Now that the mood is more relaxed, Entropic Sol seems to have thought of something and she frowns again.
units.displayText: Now that the mood is more relaxed, Entropic Sol seems to have thought of something and she frowns again.

spans.text: Now that the mood is more relaxed, Entropic Sol seems to have thought of something and she frowns again.

units.rawText: Still, I did lose to you just now. Since you don't want my core...
units.displayText: Still, I did lose to you just now. Since you don't want my core...

spans.text: Still, I
did
lose to you just now. Since you don't want my core...

units.rawText: If I win, you give back what belongs to me. How about that?
units.displayText: If I win, you give back what belongs to me. How about that?

spans.text: If I win, you give back what belongs to me. How about that?

units.rawText: What exactly is this "thing that belongs to you"?
units.displayText: What exactly is this "thing that belongs to you"?

spans.text: What exactly is this "thing that belongs to you"?

units.rawText: It might be more important than the core.
units.displayText: It might be more important than the core.

spans.text: It might be more important than the core.

units.rawText: <color=orange>...I want to know the truth.</color>
units.displayText: ...I want to know the truth.

spans.text: ...I want to know the truth.

units.rawText: The truth?
units.displayText: The truth?

spans.text: The truth?

units.rawText: Why do you, as an Entropic, have part of my original core?
units.displayText: Why do you, as an Entropic, have part of my original core?

spans.text: Why do you, as an Entropic, have part of my original core?

units.rawText: That's because Lady Malkira said that you were enemies of Tartarus, and I had to chase you out.
units.displayText: That's because Lady Malkira said that you were enemies of Tartarus, and I had to chase you out.

spans.text: That's because Lady Malkira said that you were enemies of Tartarus, and I had to chase you out.

units.rawText: But we were invited here by Malkira.
units.displayText: But we were invited here by Malkira.

spans.text: But we were invited here by Malkira.

units.rawText: Bwuh?
units.displayText: Bwuh?

spans.text: Bwuh?

units.rawText: But Lady Malkira... doesn't... lie...
units.displayText: But Lady Malkira... doesn't... lie...

spans.text: But Lady Malkira... doesn't... lie...

units.rawText: What did she tell you?
units.displayText: What did she tell you?

spans.text: What did she tell you?

units.rawText: Ever since I awoke, Lady Malkira told me that all the memories involving you were just redundant data.
units.displayText: Ever since I awoke, Lady Malkira told me that all the memories involving you were just redundant data.

spans.text: Ever since I awoke, Lady Malkira told me that all the memories involving you were just redundant data.

units.rawText: If all that was a lie, then what was her aim in telling me all that...
units.displayText: If all that was a lie, then what was her aim in telling me all that...

spans.text: If all that was a lie, then what was her aim in telling me all that...

units.rawText: Clearly it was to brainwash you and make you follow her, of course. I mean, you're pretty strong, and you've got yours truly, the legendary warrior vouching for that.
units.displayText: Clearly it was to brainwash you and make you follow her, of course. I mean, you're pretty strong, and you've got yours truly, the legendary warrior vouching for that.

spans.text: Clearly it was to brainwash you and make you follow her, of course. I mean, you're pretty strong, and you've got yours truly, the legendary warrior vouching for that.

units.rawText: But she didn't have to do that! I'm just an Entropic, and she's the leader of the Entropic swarm. She had countless ways to make me obey her...
units.displayText: But she didn't have to do that! I'm just an Entropic, and she's the leader of the Entropic swarm. She had countless ways to make me obey her...

spans.text: But she didn't have to do that! I'm just an Entropic, and she's the leader of the Entropic swarm. She had countless ways to make me obey her...

units.rawText: Well, whatever the reason is, everything will be made clear once we see Malkira.
units.displayText: Well, whatever the reason is, everything will be made clear once we see Malkira.

spans.text: Well, whatever the reason is, everything will be made clear once we see Malkira.

units.rawText: The Professor and I entered Tartarus to meet Malkira in hopes that she'll stop working with Eosphorus and stop the spread of Entropy throughout Magrasea.
units.displayText: The Professor and I entered Tartarus to meet Malkira in hopes that she'll stop working with Eosphorus and stop the spread of Entropy throughout Magrasea.

spans.text: The Professor and I entered Tartarus to meet Malkira in hopes that she'll stop working with Eosphorus and stop the spread of Entropy throughout Magrasea.

units.rawText: Since she has all the answers to our questions, you might as well come with us, Sol.
units.displayText: Since she has all the answers to our questions, you might as well come with us, Sol.

spans.text: Since she has all the answers to our questions, you might as well come with us, Sol.

units.rawText: Huh? Me? Hell yeah, of course I'm going!
units.displayText: Huh? Me? Hell yeah, of course I'm going!

spans.text: Huh? Me? Hell yeah, of course I'm going!

units.rawText: Well, I meant...
units.displayText: Well, I meant...

spans.text: Well, I meant...

units.rawText: Persicaria glances meaningfully at the girl in black.
units.displayText: Persicaria glances meaningfully at the girl in black.

spans.text: Persicaria glances meaningfully at the girl in black.

units.rawText: I'll go with you to see her.
units.displayText: I'll go with you to see her.

spans.text: I'll go with you to see her.

units.rawText: I lost, so I have to pay up. Since I agreed, I'll help make your wish come true.
units.displayText: I lost, so I have to pay up. Since I agreed, I'll help make your wish come true.

spans.text: I lost, so I have to pay up. Since I agreed, I'll help make your wish come true.

units.rawText: Also...
units.displayText: Also...

spans.text: Also...

units.rawText: Entropic Sol rubs the stake in her chest, feeling the primal yearning from deep inside her heart.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol rubs the stake in her chest, feeling the primal yearning from deep inside her heart.

spans.text: Entropic Sol rubs the stake in her chest, feeling the primal yearning from deep inside her heart.

units.rawText: I'll lose my way if I don't understand my past. I don't want to be lost again.
units.displayText: I'll lose my way if I don't understand my past. I don't want to be lost again.

spans.text: I'll lose my way if I don't understand my past. I don't want to be lost again.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Lady Malkira owes you—and me—the truth.</color>
units.displayText: Lady Malkira owes you—and me—the truth.

spans.text: Lady Malkira owes you—and me—the truth.

units.rawText: And why are you enemies with the Professor and Persicaria?
units.displayText: And why are you enemies with the Professor and Persicaria?

spans.text: And why are you enemies with the Professor and Persicaria?

units.rawText: If you don't believe us, I can show you footage of her speaking with us through that tiny Entropic.
units.displayText: If you don't believe us, I can show you footage of her speaking with us through that tiny Entropic.

spans.text: If you don't believe us, I can show you footage of her speaking with us through that tiny Entropic.

units.rawText: That tone of voice... It's definitely Lady Malkira.
units.displayText: That tone of voice... It's definitely Lady Malkira.

spans.text: That tone of voice... It's definitely Lady Malkira.

units.rawText: The intense battle is nearing an end, and the panting duo meet each other's gazes and smile.
